scope: Deterministic anticipatory input membrane upstream of Road Runner field admission.
change: Adds Hecate as a stateless daemon-boundary gate that evaluates provenance, freshness, replay, secret shape, prompt injection, authority escalation, network expansion, coherence, affect stability, readiness, and route safety before emitting ALLOW, HOLD, or RETURN.
reason: Road Runner needs an upstream liminal membrane that can detect observable hazards before signals enter the working field without inheriting execution or capital authority.
tests: local isolated validation: 9 focused tests passed before branch creation
road_runner_integration: Parallel-safe adapter seam only. No Road Runner file is imported or modified.
authority_impact: None. ALLOW permits only next-layer observation. It grants no execution, deployment, signing, broadcast, merge, repository-write, wallet, credential, or capital authority.
rollback: Revert the candidate branch or resulting squash commit. No external system, wallet, transaction, deployment, credential, capital, or Road Runner state is mutated by this change.
